documents.title: Bambu Support for PLA/PETG Technical Data Sheet V1.0
Bambu Support for PLA/PETG Safety Data Sheet (SDS20250723S05)
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: NOT STORED, CONFLICT between two official documents on the material: the TDS V1.0 (p.3 › Other Physical and Chemical Properties) says "Composition Polylactic acid", while the SDS SDS20250723S05 (Jul. 23 2025, p.4-5, section 3) lists "Thermoplastic Polyurethane 74.9-90" % by wt (CAS 1211-14-9), PETG 9.9-25 % (CAS 25640-14-6) and Additive 0.1-15.2 %. material.type is therefore left out (neither verified nor not_published) for the adjudicator; no value is picked.

TDS rows marked "N/A" by the manufacturer (stored as not_published): Glass Transition Temperature (DSC, 10 °C/min), Vicat Softening Temperature (printed "Vicar"; ISO 306, GB/T 1633), Heat Deflection Temperature (ISO 75 1.8 MPa and 0.45 MPa), Young's Modulus, Tensile Strength, Breaking Elongation Rate, Bending Modulus, Bending Strength, Impact Strength (each X-Y and Z). The TDS has no hardness row and no filament length.

TDS rows with no registry key (not stored): Printing and Storage Humidity "< 20% RH (Sealed, with desiccant)", Bed Surface Preparation "Glue", Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s, Max Overhang Angle 55°, Max Bridging Length 30 mm, Support "Turn on", Melt Index 14.3 ± 1.2 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), Crystallization Temperature N/A, Saturated Water Absorption Rate 1.02% (25 °C, 55% RH), Odor "Odorless", Skin Hazards "No available", Chemical Stability, Solubility "Insoluble in water", acid/alkali/organic-solvent "Not resistant", oil and grease "Resistant to most kinds of oil and grease", Flammability "Flammable", Combustion Products "Water, carbon oxides, nitrogen oxides".

SDS facts with no registry key (not stored): CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram or signal word; transport IMDG / DOT / ADR-RID / ICAO-IATA "Not hazardous goods"; REACH SVHC "Not listed". Section 9 gives "No data available" for melting point, density, flash point and decomposition temperature.

Drying requirement wording differs between wiki pages: the Support Filament Usage Guide (2.1) gives "Pre-print Drying: Required" and "Moisture Protection During Printing: Required"; the Filament Drying Recommendations (Appendix I) gives "Recommended" and "Not required but recommended"; the TDS gives only settings. No key holds this; recorded only. The drying wiki also says the static drying mode is not suitable for Support for PLA/PETG (rotation mode).

Store-page values compared: material.diameter 1.75 mm (agrees), material.net_weight 0.5 kg on the option value (agrees), material.diameter_tolerance ± 0.05 mm (store page only; the documents do not state it, so it is neither curated nor not_published), compat.statement (text differs, see its note).
No hex: the store page links no Hex Code document for this product and none was cached; hex is empty. Colour values: Nature (65102), Black (65103).
in_the_box is empty: no official in-the-box list exists for this filament in the documents read.
